name: Guadahortuna (Spain)
description: White field with a diagonal band of blue, white and blue from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Guadahortuna (a wavy bend between holm oaks on white).
history: Guadahortuna adopted its arms and flag officially on 19 May 2003; the flag is a rectangular cloth of 2:3, white, with a tricolour diagonal stripe, blue, white and blue, from the upper hoist corner to the lower fly.

features.role: tricolour band blue, white and blue from the upper hoist to the lower fly
